nodes.description: Public pure function computing keccak256 hash of a string input and returning uint256.
Public view function generating pseudo-random number using seed, block.difficulty, block.timestamp modulo length.
Public pure function hashing an address and a secret string into uint256.
Block timestamp used in randNum as a source of randomness.
Weak randomness: block.timestamp and block.difficulty are predictable and miner-manipulable, making randNum output predictable.
uint256 length parameter of randNum used as modulus.

edges.reason: Parameter input is read by toKeccak256 for hashing.
Parameter seed is used in randNum hash input.
Parameter length is used as modulus in randNum.
block.timestamp is consumed by randNum as a randomness source, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp flows into the weak randomness operation.
randNum executes the weak randomness operation using block.timestamp.
Parameter sender is hashed inside toHash.
Parameter secret is hashed inside toHash.
